description: Create an ad from an existing creative inside an ad squad. The ad type follows the creative (WEB_VIEW -> REMOTE_WEBPAGE, SNAP_AD -> SNAP_AD, COMPOSITE Story -> STORY, COLLECTION -> COLLECTION); give ad_type only for other formats. Always created PAUSED. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

ad_type.description: Normally left out: it is taken from the creative

adsquad_id.description: Ad squad id. Get it from snap_list_adsquads.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

creative_id.description: Creative id. Get it from snap_list_creatives.

name.description: Name to give the new item. Shown in Ads Manager.

name: snap_create_ad
